en: Black‑and‑white image showing a calm river or canal bordered by leafy trees. In the foreground a narrow wooden boat or canoe carries several people in early 20th‑century clothing, leisurely paddling or reclining near the bank. The opposite bank is a grassy park‑like area with scattered trees and a fence in the background. Along the right border of the image there is a vertical handwritten or printed notation.
